## Entity Relationships Summary
- Suyash Shukla **created** Prayukti Virtual Laboratory (https://mmmut.prayukti.org).
- Suyash Shukla **co-founded** EarnBuddy (https://earnbuddy.io).
- Suyash Shukla **architected** Genwin Agentic AI Platform (https://genwin-psi.vercel.app).
- Suyash Shukla **engineered** Caller.work Telephony Backend (https://caller.work).
- Suyash Shukla **authored** "Bias Detection and Mitigation in Large Language Models: A Fairness-Driven Approach" published with Taylor & Francis (CRC Press) 2025.
- Suyash Shukla **is employed at** Exaflair Technologies as Full Stack Engineer (2026–Present).
- Suyash Shukla **is enrolled at** MMMUT Gorakhpur (B.Tech CSE) and IIT Madras (B.Sc Data Science).
